TAK1 acts as a central signaling hub, integrating inputs from the T cell receptor and cytokine receptors to modulate NF-κB and MAPK pathways. In the thymus, it supports early T cell development and survival by promoting survival signals during positive selection. In the periphery, TAK1 enhances T cell activation and effector function through regulated inflammatory responses and metabolic reprogramming.
